Ambienti.confermaEliminazioneLogin: The recorded sign-in for this environment will be lost.
Ambienti.confermaEliminazioneSessione: The saved session for this environment will be removed.
Ambienti.confermaEliminazioneEnv: The variables in .env are not deleted: they might be useful elsewhere.

Registra.registrazioneInCorso: Recording in progress: follow the browser window that opened.

Esecuzione.altroInCorso: Another operation ({comando}) is running elsewhere: its progress isn't visible from here.

Esecuzione.salvatoSovrascritto: Saved as {file}, replacing the previous generated version.

Esecuzione.provaIntestazioneSenzaAmbiente: Run {quando}, on an environment we do not know. It is not running: it is only here to look at.

Esecuzione.provaSenzaPassi: This run left no steps to show.

Scenari.risultati: {n, plural, =0 {No scenarios found} one {# scenario found} other {# scenarios found}}

Scenari.passoNonCollegato: This step is not connected to code yet, so it cannot run.
Scenari.provatoAltrove: It was run on the {ambiente} environment: {esito}, {quando}.

Scenari.testoErrore: I can't read this scenario's text.

Scenari.nonTrovatoTesto: It was renamed, moved or deleted. Pick another one from the list.
Scenari.schermataNonPiuDisponibile: The screen from this run is gone: older runs are removed automatically. Run the scenario again to see it.

Salva.descrizione: Choose the application and the flow, and give the scenario a name that says what it checks. It will sit next to the other scenarios of that flow.
Salva.destinazione: It will be saved in {percorso}, with its steps and Page Objects
Salva.tieni: Keep it with the recorded scenarios
Salva.erroreApp: The application name can only contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
Salva.erroreFlusso: The flow name can only contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
Salva.erroreTitolo: The name must be one line with at least one letter or digit.
Salva.erroreNonTrovato: I can't find the scenario that was just generated. Generate the test again.
Salva.erroreNonRegistrato: This file does not come from a recording, so it can't be moved from here.
Salva.erroreTroppi: There are already too many scenarios with this name: choose another one.
Salva.errorePassoDuplicato: These step phrases are already defined by another saved scenario. Two definitions of the same phrase would stop every test run. Record the step with a different name, or align it to the catalog first:
Salva.errorePaginaAMano: A saved page was edited by hand and lacks methods this scenario needs. Add them by hand, or restore the generation marker:

Catalogo.descrizionePagina: The phrases the system knows, the page elements they touch, and where they need tidying up.
Catalogo.nessunoScenarioLoUsa: No scenario uses this step yet.
Catalogo.informativaSpiegazione: The same wording also exists in another application: it may be a coincidence (common names like “Sign in”). It's neither a duplicate nor a mix-up: no change is suggested.
Catalogo.nessunDisordine: No pair of phrases is too alike.
Catalogo.doppioneTitolo: Two phrases for the same thing
Catalogo.corpiDiversiTitolo: Careful: the two phrases don't do the same thing
Catalogo.corpiDiversiSpiegazione: If you merge, what “{frase}” does disappears for good along with its phrase. Look at what both do before you decide.
Catalogo.confermaCapito: I understand that what “{frase}” does will be lost.
Catalogo.annullamentoRiuscito: Undone: the files are back to how they were before the merge.
Catalogo.nuovaFraseLabel: New wording for the selected phrase
Catalogo.cosaCambieraEquivoco: {righe, plural, =0 {No scenario uses} one {# line will be rewritten, in the scenario that uses} other {# lines will be rewritten, across the scenarios that use}} “{frase}”.
Catalogo.doppioneSpiegazione: The same page element, reached with two different phrases.
Catalogo.aggiornamentoInCorso: Updating the catalog… the numbers may not include the scenario you just saved yet.
Catalogo.aggiornamentoFallito: The last automatic update failed: {dettaglio}. What you see is the last good catalog, not necessarily today's.

Catalogo.numSistemareDettaglio: {n, plural, =0 {All tidy} one {# pair to look at} other {# pairs to look at}}

Catalogo.catalogoRicostruzione: Rebuilding the catalog: it takes a few dozen seconds.

Catalogo.schedaSistemareConteggio: {n, plural, one {# pair to look at} other {# pairs to look at}}
Catalogo.stepDomanda: What can the system do today?
Catalogo.stepIntro: Every phrase you can use in a scenario, what it does and where it's already used.
Catalogo.componentiDomanda: If I change this page element, what stops working?
Catalogo.componentiIntro: Buttons, fields and links the steps touch: for each, what depends on it.
Catalogo.sistemareIntro: Nearly identical phrases: merging or telling them apart keeps the catalog simple. Every change shows what will change first.
Catalogo.cercaSegnaposto: Search a phrase, a component, a page…
Catalogo.vuotoStepTesto: Steps appear when you record a session and save the scenario.
Catalogo.suggerimentoPartenza: The catalog grows by itself: every scenario you save adds its steps.
Catalogo.vuotoComponentiTesto: A component appears when a step touches one: record a session and save the scenario.
Catalogo.vuotoComponentiNonAgganciati: {n, plural, one {The catalog step isn't linked to a page yet.} other {The # catalog steps aren't linked to a page yet.}}
Catalogo.stepSenzaComponenteTesto: This step isn't linked to a component yet. It links itself when you record a session that uses it.
Catalogo.soloScenariDelCatalogo: Only counts scenarios that use catalog phrases.
Catalogo.nessunoScenarioDipende: No scenario depends on it yet.
Catalogo.vediLaFrase: See the phrase in the Steps tab: {frase}
Catalogo.gruppoDoppioni: Two phrases for the same thing ({n})
Catalogo.anteprimaRighe: {righe, plural, =0 {No scenario uses “{frase}”.} one {# line in your scenarios will change from “{frase}” to the one you keep.} other {# lines in your scenarios will change from “{frase}” to the one you keep.}} “{frase}” will no longer exist.
Catalogo.corpiUguali: Both phrases do the same thing.
Catalogo.corpiDiversiSuggerimento: Best decided with whoever maintains the automated tests.
Catalogo.confrontoDa: What “{frase}” does today: it would be lost
Catalogo.confrontoSpiegazione: These are the instructions the system uses to run the phrase. If you don't read them, you can leave the decision to whoever maintains the automated tests.
Catalogo.esitoFusione: Done: “{da}” is now “{a}” ({righe, plural, one {# line rewritten} other {# lines rewritten}}).
Catalogo.esitoDistinzione: Done: “{da}” is now “{a}” ({righe, plural, one {# line rewritten} other {# lines rewritten}}).
Catalogo.soloUltimaFusione: You can only undo the last merge: if you do another one, this one can't be undone any more.
Catalogo.catalogoNonRigenerato: The catalog didn't update by itself: the numbers above may be out of date.
Catalogo.equivocoSpiegazione: The two phrases are nearly identical but touch different elements: they aren't duplicates, and merging them would send some scenarios to the wrong element. One of them gets another wording.
Catalogo.distinguiNonAnnullabile: This change can't be undone with a button.
Catalogo.daVerificareTesto: The two phrases look alike, but at least one isn't linked to a component yet: without that, we can't tell whether they're the same thing. Once both are, the right action will show up here.

Suggerimenti.aiuto: These are only suggestions: nothing changes unless you choose it, step by step.
Suggerimenti.prova: It touches the same page elements you used (this is proof, not an estimate)

motivo.gia-realizzata: the catalog phrase is already defined in another saved scenario.
motivo.parametri: the catalog phrase has a value that changes, and for now it cannot be replaced from here.
motivo.non-wanted: the catalog phrase is not available for new scenarios.
motivo.caratteri: the catalog phrase has characters that cannot be inserted from here.

Suggerimenti.nota: You can undo until you save. Saving without using the suggestions is perfectly fine.
Suggerimenti.applicate: {n, plural, one {You used # catalog phrase.} other {You used # catalog phrases.}} You can undo until you save.
Suggerimenti.annullate: I put your phrases back as they were.
Suggerimenti.catalogoInRitardo: The catalog will update at the next save: another job is running right now.
Suggerimenti.rifiutate: The changes did not pass the checks and were undone: {quale}. Nothing has changed.

giudice.tsc: the test could no longer be built
giudice.dry-run: not every step had its definition
giudice.validatore: a phrase is not in the catalog

errore.generico: I could not apply the choices. Nothing has been changed.
errore.scaduta: The catalog or the scenario changed after the suggestions: they are no longer valid. Generate the test again.
errore.non-applicabile: One of the chosen phrases cannot be applied. Nothing has been changed.
errore.stessa-voce: Two steps point to the same catalog phrase: choose only one.
errore.collisione: A catalog phrase is the same as the phrase of another step. Nothing has been changed.
errore.frase-non-trovata: I cannot find one of your phrases in the scenario: it may have been edited. Nothing has been changed.
errore.file-a-mano: The scenario was edited by hand: I will not touch it.
errore.modificato-a-mano: You edited the scenario after choosing: I will not undo, so you do not lose your work.
errore.gia-salvato: The scenario has already been saved: it cannot be undone from here.
